title: Library workshop planning
scenario: Library staff and volunteers plan an adult digital-skills workshop with capacity, access preferences, and an unresolved equipment question.
summary:
The library team planned a Saturday afternoon workshop on organising files. The session would use library laptops and fictional documents to practise folders and search, with ten participant places and a waiting list. Teaching was scheduled for 2–3:30, within a longer room reservation for setup and cleanup. The proposed format combined a short demonstration with practice, questions, and a break. Printed handouts and digital copies were discussed as part of the materials.

Equipment readiness was the main outstanding issue: eight laptops worked and two still needed updates and testing. The team would wait for the device checks before finalising the announcement. They also discussed using a reading alcove during the break, revising registration messages, and keeping the workshop focused rather than offering general computer troubleshooting.
